hero.title: AURELLE
hero.subtitle: Digital assistant for booking beauty services
hero.description: Platform connecting the best beauty masters and salons across Uzbekistan in one place. AURELLE is created for those who value their time, service quality, and convenience — for both clients and businesses.

clients.title: For Clients
clients.whatIsItAnswer: AURELLE is a simple and convenient way to find a master and book online, without calls, messages, and unnecessary hassle.
clients.benefit1: Search for verified masters in the best salons
clients.benefit2: Online booking at a convenient time in a couple of clicks
clients.benefit4: Time savings — no calls or waiting
clients.benefit5: Transparency: masters, services, schedule in one place
clients.summary: You don't "search for a salon", you book with a specific master when it's convenient for you.

business.title: For Salons and Masters
business.whatIsItAnswer: AURELLE is a tool for attracting clients and managing bookings.
business.benefit3: Fewer cancellations and forgotten visits thanks to reminders
business.benefit5: Increased master workload and salon revenue
business.summary: You spend less time on administration and more on work and business growth.

why.title: Why is it needed?
why.text1: The beauty market has long outgrown phone calls, notebooks, and WhatsApp chaos.
why.text2: AURELLE is a unified platform where it's convenient for clients to book, masters to work, and salons to earn.

summary.title: Short and Clear
summary.forClients: For clients — a quick and convenient way to book with a master
summary.forBusiness: For business — client flow and booking automation
summary.tagline: No unnecessary words. No confusion. Everything in one place.
